profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI/GenAI | Distributed Systems | Cloud Infrastructure | System Design | Machine Learning | AWS | Kubernetes | Kafka | Ruby | Python
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building large-scale, distributed, and highly available systems across healthcare, cloud platforms, IoT, and e-commerce. Proven ability to design low-latency APIs, optimize system performance, and deliver production-grade solutions at scale. Strong background in backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and data-driven services, with experience integrating machine learning models into real-world applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: 
●	Discuss new features and implement them.
●	Discuss issues and fix them.
●	Code and design software applications. 
●	Analyze software requirements, implement new features and deploy the software applications. 
●	Use tools to build software applications such as Sublime Text, Visual Studio Code, Vim.

●	Work with SQL databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc. 
●	Work with version control, primarily Git.

projects.title: Health insurance premium predictor - http://health-insurance-predictor-nguyentantho.pythonanywhere.com
projects.description: The health insurance predictor project enables accurate pricing of insurance policies by incorporating individual characteristics and risk factors. By analyzing variables such as age, weight, height, smoking status, and potentially other health-related data, the project can estimate insurance premiums that align with the assessed risk level of each individual. This ensures fair pricing and helps insurance companies manage their financial risks effectively.

projects.title: Movie Recommender - http://movie-recommender-nguyentantho.pythonanywhere.com
projects.description: The movie recommender system leverages the K-nearest neighbor algorithm to effectively predict movies that align with customers' preferences, thereby enhancing their viewing experience. By identifying a group of K individuals with comparable movie preferences, the model generates tailored recommendations to users.
